artifacts.name: oral-window-p12-CONTEXT-DIAGNOSTIC.glb
artifacts.role: rejected prototype: authored local floor/gingiva transition

scope.en: Negative whole-mouth readability result. Local seam work did not make the full closed-pose context useful or complete. Gold display-cut faces are not reconstructed tissue.
scope.zh: 全口腔可读性未达标。局部接缝修整未能使闭口姿态的整体展示清楚或完整。金色展示切口并非重建组织。

failure.en: Local floor/gingiva seam improved, but full oral context remains heavily occluded.
failure.zh: 口底／下牙龈局部接缝有所改善，但整体口腔仍严重遮挡。

cause.en: Original closed-pose gingival/palatal walls and tongue obscure the repaired region.
cause.zh: 原始闭口姿态下的牙龈／腭壁和舌体遮住了修整区域。

fix.en: Bounded local transition plus the same clearly marked buccal display window in both control and prototype.
fix.zh: 仅修整局部过渡，并在对照和原型中使用相同、明确标示的颊侧展示窗口。

retest.en: Matched exact-export colored and neutral-tissue views still fail the whole-mouth readability target. Local contact tests do not certify the entire model.
retest.zh: 匹配的精确导出彩色与中性组织材质视图仍未达到全口腔可读性目标。局部接触测试不能证明整个模型合格。

lesson.en: Solve presentation and pose scope before polishing a hidden seam; better local topology does not prove a useful whole-organ teaching view.
lesson.zh: 先解决展示与姿态范围，再打磨隐藏接缝；局部拓扑改善不代表整体器官教学视图有用。

limitations: Gland meshes 0–5 omitted in both displayed context exports.
No separate authored tongue inserted; original teeth, tongue/papillae and palate retained in native placement.
No whole-mouth, clinical, anatomy completeness or runtime approval.
Large control/prototype/source GLBs and full history are deliberately not included.

label.zh: 匹配整体对照 · 全口腔未通过
